about.title: About Sale Driving School
about.p1: Sale Driving School is led by Saša Anđelković and a young, energetic team of licensed instructors. We are based in Kostolac at Rudarska bb, serving learners from Kostolac, Požarevac, and nearby areas.
about.p2: Our approach is simple: solid driver training, road safety, and trust. No stiff bureaucracy — clear explanations, patience, and a modern way of learning.
about.p3: Whether you are starting B category training or returning to the wheel after a long break, we guide you from theory through to the driving test.

training.title: B Category Driver Training

theory.title: Theory classes
theory.text: You can start theory training from age 16. We cover traffic rules, safety, and the situations you will face in the exam and on the road.

practice.title: Practical driving lessons
practice.text: You can take the practical exam from age 17. Lessons build habits: parking, city driving, faster roads, and calm reactions.

exam.title: Exam preparation
exam.text: We prepare you for both the theory and practical parts — with clear expectations and extra lessons when needed.

age.q: At what age can I enroll for B category training?
age.a: You can start theory from age 16 and take the practical exam from age 17. We confirm enrollment requirements when you apply at Sale Driving School in Kostolac.

duration.q: How long does driver training take?
duration.a: It depends on your pace, available slots, and the lesson count set by regulations. Many learners finish within a few months — we agree on a plan at the start.

documents.q: What documents do I need to enroll in a driving school?
documents.a: Typically an ID card (or passport), a medical certificate, and other documents required by current rules. We send you the checklist when you apply.

refresher.q: Do you offer refresher driving lessons?
refresher.a: Yes. Refresher driving lessons in Kostolac are for licensed drivers who want more confidence and practice — including drivers who rarely get behind the wheel.

hours.q: What are Sale Driving School opening hours?
hours.a: According to the shop front: weekdays 8am–4pm, closed Saturday and Sunday. Call +381 63 826 8876 to confirm the current schedule.

location.q: Where is Sale Driving School in Kostolac?
location.a: At Rudarska bb, Kostolac (Požarevac municipality). We welcome learners from Kostolac, Požarevac, and nearby areas.

price.q: How much does driving school training cost in Kostolac?
price.a: We share current prices for B category training and refresher lessons individually — contact us for an exact quote.

exam.q: How do you prepare for the B category driving test?
exam.a: We cover theory and practical lessons with exam situations in mind. Extra driving hours can be added so you take the test ready.
